evals.prompt: Write a new PPO/TIS mechanism analysis passage for the llm-knowledge Obsidian wiki, including a policy ratio, conditional probability, clipping interval, and two-line derivation. Deliver Markdown ready to save and complete the formula self-check.
evals.expected_output: Use only $...$ and $$ delimiters on their own lines; use \mid for conditioning, \mathrm for semantic subscripts, \operatorname for named functions, and aligned for multiline derivations. Report the strict checker command and its actual result.

evals.prompt: Fix formulas in an Obsidian page that mixes \(x\), \[x\], and $$x$$ and contains accept\_rate, p_{train-old}, and |w-1|. Preserve the mathematical meaning and explain the changes.
evals.expected_output: Standardize on dollar delimiters; separate metric/API identifiers from mathematical symbols, make semantic subscripts such as train-old upright, and use \lvert...\rvert for absolute value. Run strict checking after the edits and resolve all errors and warnings.

evals.prompt: Review a Markdown table whose cells contain p(y|x), a display equation, and a long single-line equation. Identify rendering risks and rewrite it according to llm-knowledge conventions.
evals.expected_output: Identify raw vertical bars as conflicting with Markdown columns, display equations as unsuitable inside tables, and long derivations as needing aligned. Retain short inline p(y\mid x) in the table, move the other equations outside, and run check_math.py --strict.
